name: Brown Soup Stock
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ½ cup carrot, cut in dice

ingredients.name: ½ cup turnip, cut in dice

ingredients.name: ½ cup onion, cut in dice
ingredients.originalText: ½ cup onion, cut in dice

ingredients.name: ½ cup celery, cut in dice
ingredients.originalText: ½ cup celery, cut in dice

instructions.text: Wipe beef, and cut the lean meat in inch cubes.
Brown one-third of meat in hot frying-pan in marrow from a marrow-bone.
Put remaining two-thirds with bone and fat in soup kettle, add water, and let stand for thirty minutes.
Place on back of range, add browned meat, and heat gradually to boiling-point.
As scum rises it should be removed.
Cover, and cook slowly six hours, keeping below boiling-point during cooking.
Add vegetables and seasonings, cook one and one-half hours, strain, and cool as quickly as possible.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wipe beef, and cut the lean meat in inch cubes.
2. Brown one-third of meat in hot frying-pan in marrow from a marrow-bone.
3. Put remaining two-thirds with bone and fat in soup kettle, add water, and let stand for thirty minutes.
4. Place on back of range, add browned meat, and heat gradually to boiling-point.
5. As scum rises it should be removed.
6. Cover, and cook slowly six hours, keeping below boiling-point during cooking.
7. Add vegetables and seasonings, cook one and one-half hours, strain, and cool as quickly as possible.
